methodology.updates: Synchronous committed DOM; performance.now in-page. React flushSync, Solid flush, Rivet batch. No virtualization.
methodology.cpu: Chromium TaskDuration with threadTicks: main-thread task CPU delta including evaluation/CDP bookkeeping; excludes GPU/workers and is not isolated framework CPU.
methodology.frames: Forced layout then two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; frame settle is not a direct paint metric.
methodology.memory: Chromium forced-GC JavaScript heap, not browser process RSS. Warmed page baseline; five disposal cycles; caches intentionally remain.
methodology.sampling: Fresh browser context per framework/row/repeat. Framework order rotates each repeat. Three warmup updates before sampled updates at each percentage. Validation outside measurement.
